name: Pronunciation Guide
description: Creates pronunciation guidance with phonetic descriptions, practice patterns, and common error corrections for language learners. Produces a targeted pronunciation practice plan for specific sounds or patterns in the target language. Use when a learner asks to improve pronunciation, practice specific sounds, reduce accent, or learn phonetic patterns in a target language. Do NOT use for conversation practice (use `conversation-practice`), for grammar instruction (use `grammar-practice`), or for reading skills (use `speed-reading`).
